items.title: Ernest McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Is that when Grunewald's head up on Camp Street or some place? I remember that.

ctx.x: As far as that instrument is concerned, I went to GI school for harmony. Oh yeah. And I took some ear training and stuff. I went to school about two years and a half.

Is that when Grunewald's head up on Camp Street or some place? I remember that. Quite a few fellows were up there, I remember. We were just about out of tape. Is there any other thing you'd like to add about your life story?
Well, I still haven't got as far as I want to go.
